caption: The drawing depicts a tall, wooden piece of furniture consisting of two main sections: an upper cabinet and a lower chest of drawers. The upper section features two glass-paneled doors with an arched design, framed by vertical stained wooden slats, and is topped with a decorative crest that includes three finials and a central square with a checkerboard pattern. The wood in this section is dark brown with reddish undertones. Below the glass doors, there is a smaller compartment with a semi-circular archway door in the center, flanked by vertical panels. The lower section is comprised of three wide drawers, each with two oval brass pulls, and the wood of the drawer fronts is lighter in color compared to the darker frame. The legs are slender and taper slightly towards the bottom, also rendered in a dark brown wood. The background is a plain, light cream or beige with no additional objects or details. The artist’s signature “C. Bowman” appears in the lower right corner.
title: Desk
